glosses: to injure pasterns by catching one leg with the other
to run across the field looking for game spoor
to line (to mark or cover with lines)
to even, to level using a strickle
to separate (to disunite from a group or mass)
to graze (to rub or touch lightly the surface of (a thing) in passing)
to shell, to strafe [with instrumental ‘with what’]
